references.text: The warning against taking any of the devoted things into one's house, which would bring a curse
Joshua's warning to stay away from the devoted things so as not to bring disaster upon Israel's camp
Achan's sin when he took some of the devoted things, which led to the Lord's anger against Israel
Moses asks the Lord to turn away his burning anger from the people
God's promise to Abraham to multiply his offspring because he was obedient
God's promise to Isaac to make his descendants as numerous as the stars in the sky
The Lord's promise to show mercy and gather the people again
The Lord remembered his covenant and showed compassion according to his great grace
The Lord left the people for a moment in anger, but will gather them with great mercy
